description: This Java class defines a factory for creating Actor Props for the ThingPersistenceActor in an Akka-based system. It follows the singleton pattern and provides a method 'props' to generate Props objects configured with specific ThingId and pub/sub components.

classes.name: DefaultThingPersistenceActorPropsFactory
classes.description: Immutable singleton factory class for creating Props for ThingPersistenceActor, implementing the ThingPersistenceActorPropsFactory interface.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DefaultThingPersistenceActorPropsFactory.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props for a ThingPersistenceActor using the provided ThingId and DistributedPub.
